Core.pitch: The registries every other tool plugs into. Installed as a unit.

Network.pitch: Place, find, swap and move between operators.

Parameters.pitch: Promote, bind, link, randomize and reference parameters.

Project.pitch: Saving, backups, media files and housekeeping.

Developer.pitch: Extensions, editor integration and kits for your own tools.

Miscellaneous.pitch: Small helpers that fit nowhere else.

Time & sequencing.pitch: Timelines, tempo, presets and sequences that move over time.

Control & mapping.pitch: MIDI, OSC, your phone and hardware controllers.

CHOPs & sensing.pitch: CHOP operators: shape, generate and read channels.

Visual.pitch: TOP operators: distort, colour, mask and generate images.

3D and Particles.pitch: POP operators, particle systems and 3D stacks.

Show & output.pitch: Scenes, slides, recording, audio and the perform window.

Riding a GeoPilot, the controls the pilot owns grey out with a note saying why: the layouts, the move channels and speeds, the collisions, and Dead Zone and Smoothing, which the pilot already applies. Mouse Look: drag inside the node viewer to look around, as on the palette cameraViewport; on a GeoPilot set to Carry, a sideways drag turns the body. Pan and Dolly brings the rest of cameraViewport's navigation: drag with the other button to truck and pedestal, the middle button to dolly and pan, the wheel to dolly. Save your own layouts: map a controller, type a name into Control Preset and pulse Capture Layout; the layouts live in a Layout Library you can externalize beside the component, and Current Layout says which one is applied and whether you changed it.
